let reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~(contents : DB.doc_contents) :
    doc_meta * anchor list =
  DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_id;
  DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id ~contents ~force:false;
  (match contents with
  | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id c
  | DB.Deleted -> ());
  let doc_meta =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id with
    | Some m -> m
    | None -> failwith "internal error: just-registered document not found"
  in
  let changed =
    Anchor.relocate_stale_anchors db ~doc_id ~doc_revision:doc_meta.revision
  in
  (doc_meta, changed)

let add_file db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t)
    (text_source : Util.Text_source.t) : doc_meta * anchor list =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      ensure_source_declared db source_doc.source;
      let doc_id =
        DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:source_doc.source
          ~locator:source_doc.locator
          ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents)
      in
      DB.Containers.index db ~doc_id src_doc;
      reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id
        ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents))

item.text:
If the anchor text matches in multiple files, relocation selects **one** candidate automatically. It ranks candidates by matched text coverage, then by the number of matching hits, and finally by lowest document ID. The original file gets no preference, and there is no ambiguity check. The selected file becomes the anchor’s location. [Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-nocomment_nomd_notest/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:348)

That is deterministic, but it is **not desirable when the copies may be unrelated**: an anchor can move to the wrong file while appearing successfully relocated. The tests explicitly document this false positive. A safer policy would prefer an exact match in the original file and leave ambiguous matches for review when the original text is gone. [Text_api_tests.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-nocomment_nomd_notest/base-libs/text/tests/Text_api_tests.ml:1096)
